task_description: Write a method in Dafny that takes in an array and element and checks whether all items in the array are equal to the given element.

Method Signature:
    method AllItemsEqualToElement(a: array<int>, e: int) returns (result: bool)

    - If the method returns true, all items in the array are equal to the given element e
- If the method returns false, there exists at least one item in the array that is not equal to e
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method AllElementsEqualTo(a: array<int>, x: int) returns (result: bool)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The input array should not be null
    
Dafny specification:
    requires a != null
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The result is true if and only if every element in the array equals x
- The result is false if there exists at least one element in the array that does not equal x

Dafny specification:
    ensures result <==> forall i :: 0 <= i < a.Length ==> a[i] == x
  
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method AllElementsEqualTo(a: array<int>, x: int) returns (result: bool)
    requires a != null
    ensures result <==> forall i :: 0 <= i < a.Length ==> a[i] == x
{
    result := true;
    var i := 0;
    while i < a.Length
        invariant 0 <= i <= a.Length
        invariant result ==> forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> a[k] == x
        invariant !result ==> exists k :: 0 <= k < i && a[k] != x
    {
        if a[i] != x {
            result := false;
            break;
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
